_doc: Sense lists for pick_candidates. Each entry: aliases (normalised query strings that select it) and senses (id, label shown on the tile, prompt fed to OpenCLIP; prompt null = 'unknown/something else', filled from the raw query with diversity). Edit freely; no code changes needed.
